strategies.note: Rules fixed on 2026-09-27 from week 3; only later weeks test them. Replays are 10% swipes on the sent line.

rules.label: Crowd majority, one vote per player
rules.how: every player anyone called, moved 10% the way most callers went

rules.label: Fades only
rules.how: every player any fan faded, faded 10%; boosts ignored

rules.label: Fade mid-tier players fans boosted
rules.how: every player any fan boosted who projects 14-20 pts, faded 10%

rules.label: Specialists
rules.how: REB on WR/TE, Nana Owusu on RBs, RJS on RBs, their direction at 10%

rules.label: Calls at 10%, as made
rules.how: every call made with a 10% swipe (or a stat arrow), as the fan made it

rules.label: Calls at 20-30%, as made
rules.how: every call made with a 20% or 30% swipe, as the fan made it
